en.headline: Hong Kong man returns home after 26 years in Philippine prison
en.dek: Tang Lung-wai, 55, arrived at Hong Kong International Airport on Tuesday evening accompanied by Immigration Department officers after completing his sentence for a drug conviction he has long disputed.
body: A Hong Kong man who spent 26 years in Philippine custody returned to the city on Tuesday evening after completing his sentence for a drug-related conviction he has consistently maintained was wrongful.

Tang Lung-wai, 55, arrived at Hong Kong International Airport from Manila accompanied by Immigration Department officers and was reunited with family members, including his elder brother Billy Tang Lung-piu. Asked how he felt, Tang said: “After spending 26 years in hell, I am unflappable.”

The Immigration Department said it had coordinated with the Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong, the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines and the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Singapore after learning that Tang had completed his sentence. Officers were sent to Manila to arrange the return, and travel documents were issued promptly to accelerate the process.

Tang was arrested in Manila in July 2000 and later convicted in 2011 of possessing methamphetamine. He received a life sentence, which under Philippine law carries a maximum term of 40 years. He has long maintained his innocence, citing immigration records that he said showed he was not in the country at the time police claimed to have been monitoring him. A change in the Philippines’ good-conduct time allowance rules in late 2024 allowed life-sentence prisoners to apply for release after 21 and a half years, paving the way for his discharge.

The government said the Immigration Department would continue to follow up and provide feasible assistance. Tang’s brother thanked the relevant authorities and supporters who had helped over the years.

zh.headline: 港人鄧龍威菲律賓服刑26年後返港 入境處人員陪同
zh.dek: 55歲鄧龍威周二晚在入境處人員陪同下由馬尼拉返抵香港國際機場，結束因藏毒案在菲國渡過的26年鐵窗生涯，他一直堅稱無罪。
body: 一名在菲律賓服刑26年的港人鄧龍威，周二晚在入境事務處人員陪同下由馬尼拉返抵香港國際機場，結束異國鐵窗生涯，並與家人團聚。
55歲的鄧龍威抵達後與兄長鄧龍標等人相擁。被問及感受時，他表示：「經過26年地獄生活後，我已經處變不驚。」入境處表示，得悉該名港人完成服刑後，即與外交部駐港公署、中國駐菲律賓大使館及香港駐新加坡經濟貿易辦事處協調，並派員赴馬尼拉安排遣返，即時簽發回港證件以加快程序。
鄧龍威於2000年7月在馬尼拉被捕，2011年被裁定藏有冰毒罪名成立，判處終身監禁。他多年來堅稱無罪，指出入境紀錄顯示案發時他並不在當地。菲律賓於2024年底修訂良好行為扣減刑期計算方法，終身監禁囚犯服刑21年半後可申請出獄，令他得以提早獲釋。
政府表示，入境處會繼續跟進個案並提供可行協助。鄧龍威兄長感謝外交部駐港公署、駐菲大使館、特區政府、律師及入境處等多方多年協助。
